events.title: 🎉 Grandkids, Steam Next Fest is on! Come play Senior Survival Club!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has begun! But in all this chaos, Grandma's little grandbaby has gone missing. events.title: Grandchildren, I've given the demo a makeover for Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello, my sweet grandchildren! It's your Grandma~I've put up a brand-new demo for this October's Steam Next Fest. Were you sad that Grandma went quiet for so long? I wasn't slacking off, dears. I've been fixing up the Club from top to bottom. Let me tell you what's changed.It looks better nowI touched up the art for the characters, the weapons and the maps, and every effect has been swapped for a new one. events.title: Senior Survival Club Demo: Our Grandmas Are Finally Ready to Take on the World!
events.summary: Hello everyone,Finally, the day has come. Our small team is proud to present the first demo of Senior Survival Club, a game we've poured our love and passion into for a long time. Can you imagine a story where ordinary seniors from a nursing home survive a zombie apocalypse? A grandma twisting zombie necks on a journey to find her beloved grandson.
